sloka: ब्रह्माणम् बोधयन्त्यद्य तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम् ।आदित्यः सह चन्द्रेण यथा भूतधरां शुभाम् ॥२-१४-५०॥
transliteration: brahmāṇam bodhayantyadya tathā tvāṁ bodhayāmyaham ।ādityaḥ saha candreṇa yathā bhūtadharāṁ śubhām ॥2-14-50॥

translations.english: As the Sun along with the Moon awakens the auspicious earth which supports all beings, in the same way I am awakening you today.
